services.name: Exit Glacier Guides: Ice Hiking
services.desc: This six hour tour is popular with clients that don't shy away from exercise on their vacations. The picturesque path to the glacier is a mixture of back-country and on-trail trekking and the view from the top of the 1400ft of elevation that we gain while traveling over 1.5 miles of trail is absolutely stunning.

services.name: Exit Glacier Guides: Helicopter Ice Hiking
services.desc: Intimate and remote helicopter access to a secluded glacial environment for a private guided ice hiking tour. This tour's difficulty is highly customizable for each group of clients. We have a lot of terrain available for trekking, so the guides can cater to how much or how little you want to travel around on the glacier in the time available.

services.name: Exit Glacier Guides: Ice Climbing Trip
services.desc: You don't need any experience or special equipment to come climb with us on this tour, just a sense of adventure. We provide small client to guide ratios of 3:1 on this tour, which is led by experienced instructors who use carefully maintained equipment to lead you out onto the ice.

services.name: Exit Glacier Guides: Helicopter Ice Climbing
services.desc: The ultimate climbing experience that is completely customized to your comfort level. This tour uses a helicopter to access the climbing area.This trip requires a commitment of about 5 hours with about 3.5 - 4 hours being spent on the glacier. Minimum Age 15

services.name: Exit Glacier Guides: Helicopter Backcountry Glacier Camping
services.desc: An amazing multi-day, Alaskan camping and backcountry excursion in an isolated valley encircled with hanging glaciers and steep mountain peaks. Using an R44 helicopter as transportation for this tour, we are dropped into an area that is far removed from any signs of human activity.

services.name: Exit Glacier Guides: Lower Glacier Naturalist Hike
services.desc: Take a beautiful easy hike to a view of Exit Glacier. Learn how this magnificent chunk of ice has affected the geology, biology, and even the weather in the beautiful Resurrection Valley. We’ll hike through a history book of nature as we make our way up to the face of this stunning glacier in Kenai Fjords National Park. EASY

services.name: Exit Glacier Guides: Harding Icefield Hike
services.desc: Climb into the last ice age. This strenuous trek is a truly epic day of expansive views and great exercise. The “HIT” has been called a “life hike” for it is unlikely to experience anything like this again. This trek climbs 3000 feet alongside Exit Glacier as it passes through several climatic zones.

services.name: Exit Glacier Guides: Lost Lake
services.desc: TRAVEL TO THE SUBARCTIC- Check the guide books — Lost Lake Trail is often described as among the best on the Kenai Peninsula. This trek begins within a northern rainforest, climbs into a boreal forest, then ends in a wide and wild tundra landscape where black and brown bear sometimes can be spotted. Views are expansive and stunning. 4-10 Miles r/t

services.name: Liquid Adventures: Half Day Rainforest and Waterfall Coastal Explorer
services.desc: The kayak day begins at 7:30 am at the Liquid Adventures office in Seward, Alaska. Explore the coastline and encounter great opportunities for wildlife viewing while going further away from Seward into Alaska’s great wilderness.

services.name: Liquid Adventures: Bear Glacier Iceberg Paddleboarding
services.desc: Have you ever dreamed of paddleboarding next to a Glacier? Or maybe standing on an SUP staring up at giant Icebergs? In Alaska, you can do just that. We offer two access options for this trip. Watertaxi or Helicopter at additional cost

blurb: Exit Glacier Guides offers guided hikes on glaciers and alpine areas around Seward, Alaska, including helicopter-accessed glacier hikes. They emphasize safety with a dedicated guide training program and have been operating since 2004. Their adventures include glacier hiking, mountaineering clinics, and alpine hiking trips.
